description_en: Queries the backup status of servers that are associated with an anti-ransomware backup policy
description_zh: 查询防勒索备份策略的服务器备份状态
name: DescribeBackupMachineStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware backup policy.
You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server to query.
You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicy](~~DescribeBackupPolicy~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的服务器的UUID。
调用[DescribeBackupPolicy](~~DescribeBackupPolicy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The version of the protection policy. Valid values:

1.0.0: The version of the protection policy is 1.0.0.
2.0.0: The version of the protection policy is 2.0.0
parameters.help_zh:
防护策略的版本。取值：

1.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为1.0.0
2.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为2.0.0
parameters.name: policy_version
